hooks.command: input=$(cat); file_path=$(printf '%s' "$input" | grep -o '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/'); case "$file_path" in *pubspec.yaml|*lib/core/colors.dart|*lib/core/theme_mode_manager.dart) echo 'Reminder: this file backs a documented convention in AGENTS.md (font/icon/color/theme). If this change alters that convention, update AGENTS.md in the same commit.' >&2 ;; esac
